correctness.rationale: The two products enforce a common fixed root and prescribe two image subsets. Inclusion–exclusion exactly counts surjective colorings on complementary domains, valid for all n≥1. Uniform lower and upper coloring bounds yield the rank-pair logarithmic weight estimate; calculus controls tails on both sides of \(n/\log n\) at a superexponential margin; compact approximation gives full LDP upper/lower bounds and good rate. Exhaustive independent finite mapping enumeration n≤4 and recurrence checks cross-validate the exact formula. Finite checks are not used as proof of infinite asymptotics.

value.rationale: Null multiplication is intrinsic to finite full transformation semigroups and is the recognized dominant mechanism for rare commuting selfmaps. Scalar counts and the known \(n/\log n\) typical scale do not quantify rare asymmetric rank-pair costs. The exact bivariate finite census and full additive good LDP give natural non-implied invariant information across all n, including rates of atypical simultaneous image sizes and a rigorous exponential-scale independence property.
